questions.text:
Name a geographic environment AND a cultural process to use to answer both parts of the question.

Use the space provided to draw an annotated map(s) and/or diagram(s) to explain how your chosen cultural process has impacted on your chosen geographic environment.

questions.markingGuide: Achievement (N1-N2): Includes some relevant description of the cultural process with little or no evidence. Partially analyses how the cultural process has impacted the environment. Merit (A3-A4): Includes some supporting case study evidence. Analyses how the cultural process has impacted the environment. Excellence (M5-M6): Includes some detailed supporting case study evidence. Analyses how the operation of the cultural process has impacted the natural or cultural environment.

questions.text:
How does the cultural process operate to create impacts on people in the geographic environment?

Your response to part (b) should include:
- how the operation of the cultural process has created impacts on people
- links between the elements of the cultural process to draw conclusions
- integrated comprehensive supporting case study evidence.
questions.expectedAnswer: Analyses how the cultural process impacts people in the geographic environment, drawing...
questions.markingGuide: Achievement (N1-N2): Describes where or how people are impacted with little analysis. Merit (A3-A4): Includes supporting case study evidence. Describes how the cultural process operates to create impacts on people. Excellence (M5-E8): Includes detailed supporting case study evidence. Analyses how the cultural process creates impacts on people with insight, drawing conclusions about links between elements. At E7-E8, integrates comprehensive evidence throughout and analyses the links to draw conclusions about how the cultural process creates impacts on people.
